title: Which Entries Are Netted Into the Credited Sum of a Keyturn Host Payout Account
content:
Which entries are netted into the credited sum of a Keyturn Host Payout Account turns on whether a transfer has come back unpaid and on whether money has gone out since it did. In each case the netting leaves out the reserves taken and the reserves freed, and the result is rounded half to even to two decimal places.

**First case.** Where a transfer has come back unpaid on the account in the twelve months up to that day and no transfer has gone out since it came back, every entry ever booked to the account is netted and the money put back by a returned transfer is then held out of the credited sum, because it has not yet been sent anywhere.

**Second case.** Where a transfer has come back unpaid on the account in the twelve months up to that day and a transfer has gone out since it came back, every entry ever booked to the account is netted.

**Third case.** In every other case, the entries booked to the account in the twelve months up to that day are netted.

## The two tests, held apart

The first test is whether any transfer came back unpaid in the twelve months up to that day. Where none did, neither of the first two cases can be met and the third governs. The second test, which is asked only once the first is answered, is whether a transfer has gone out since the day of the most recent return: where none has, the first case governs; where one has, the second.

## On hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical account whose entries over its whole life net to 9000.00 USD once the reserves taken and the reserves freed are left out, whose entries in the twelve months up to that day net to 7000.00 USD on the same footing, and on which returned transfers have put 1200.00 USD back.

- With a return inside the twelve months and no transfer out since it, the credited sum is 9000.00 USD less 1200.00 USD, which is 7800.00 USD.
- With a return inside the twelve months and a transfer out since it, the credited sum is 9000.00 USD.
- With no return inside the twelve months, the credited sum is 7000.00 USD.

The records that settle it are the account's own ledger: the returned transfers booked to it and the day of the most recent one, the transfers released from it and the day of the most recent one, and the entries themselves.
